title: AdjudicationResult
description: Payload: the answer to an AdjudicationRequested (S9). It repeats the request's cache key (model, cropHash, candidateSetHash) so the event stands alone, and the ledger checks it matches. A request is answered once. Counts against the run's budget (INV-2). Agreement on one crop is one piece of evidence (INV-6); the cache key is (cropHash, candidateSetHash, model).

choice.description: A candidate workId, or null for none of them.
